import mujoco, json, numpy as np
m = mujoco.MjModel.from_xml_path("mjcf.xml")
joints=[]
for i in range(m.njnt):
    name=mujoco.mj_id2name(m,mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_JOINT,i)
    jt=m.jnt_type[i]
    tname={0:"free",1:"ball",2:"slide",3:"hinge"}[jt]
    axis=m.jnt_axis[i].tolist()
    if m.jnt_limited[i]:
        rng=m.jnt_range[i].tolist()
    else:
        rng=None
    joints.append({"name":name,"type":tname,"axis":axis,"range":rng})
acts=[]
for i in range(m.nu):
    name=mujoco.mj_id2name(m,mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_ACTUATOR,i)
    trnid=m.actuator_trnid[i,0]
    jn=mujoco.mj_id2name(m,mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_JOINT,trnid)
    cr=m.actuator_ctrlrange[i].tolist() if m.actuator_ctrllimited[i] else None
    acts.append({"name":name,"joint":jn,"ctrlrange":cr})
# free joints -> graspable
free=[mujoco.mj_id2name(m,mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_JOINT,i) for i in range(m.njnt) if m.jnt_type[i]==0]
print(json.dumps({"njnt":m.njnt,"nu":m.nu,"nq":m.nq,"nv":m.nv,"joints":joints,"acts":acts,"free":free}))
